#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Simple health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# Exits with code 0 if all services are healthy, 1 otherwise.

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
HOST="127.0.0.1"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3

check_port() {
  local host="$1"
  local port="$2"

  # Try using curl if available (preferred)
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if curl -sS --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "http://${host}:${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "PORT ${port}: OK (responding)"
      return 0
    else
      echo "PORT ${port}: DOWN (no response)"
      return 1
    fi
  fi

  # Fallback to nc (netcat) if curl isn't available
  if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "$host" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "PORT ${port}: OK (open)"
      return 0
    else
      echo "PORT ${port}: DOWN (no response)"
      return 1
    fi
  fi

  echo "ERROR: Neither curl nor nc is available to perform health checks." >&2
  return 2
}

main() {
  local overall_status=0

  echo "Running health check against ${HOST}..."

  for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    if ! check_port "$HOST" "$port"; then
      # Only set to failure if it's currently success (don't overwrite more severe codes)
      if [[ $overall_status -eq 0 ]]; then
        overall_status=1
      fi
    fi
  done

  if [[ $overall_status -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "All services are healthy."
  else
    echo "One or more services are DOWN."
  fi

  exit "$overall_status"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# - Checks HTTP responses on ports 3000 and 8080
# - Reads .env.test and includes all key/value pairs
# - Sends a JSON health report via POST to http://localhost:3003/api/health-report
# Exits with code 0 if all services are healthy, 1 otherwise.

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
HOST="127.0.0.1"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"

require_curl() {
  if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: curl is required for this script to run." >&2
    exit 2
  fi
}

check_port() {
  local host="$1"
  local port="$2"

  if curl -sS --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "http://${host}:${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "PORT ${port}: OK (responding)"
    return 0
  else
    echo "PORT ${port}: DOWN (no response)"
    return 1
  fi
}

# Very small JSON escaper for values in .env (handles backslash, quotes, newlines, tabs)
json_escape() {
  local s=$1
  s=${s//\\/\\\\}
  s=${s//\"/\\\"}
  s=${s//$'\n'/\\n}
  s=${s//$'\r'/\\r}
  s=${s//$'\t'/\\t}
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

# Build JSON object from .env.test file
build_env_json() {
  local file="$1"
  local first=1

  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
    echo "{}"
    return 0
  fi

  printf '{'
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Trim leading/trailing whitespace
    line="${line##[[:space:]]*}"
    line="${line%%[[:space:]]*}"

    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "${line:0:1}" == "#" ]] && continue

    # Split on first '='
    key=${line%%=*}
    value=${line#*=}

    # Trim whitespace around key and value
    key="${key##[[:space:]]}"
    key="${key%%[[:space:]]}"
    value="${value##[[:space:]]}"
    value="${value%%[[:space:]]}"

    # Strip optional surrounding quotes from value
    if [[ "${value:0:1}" == '"' && "${value: -1}" == '"' ]]; then
      value="${value:1:${#value}-2}"
    elif [[ "${value:0:1}" == "'" && "${value: -1}" == "'" ]]; then
      value="${value:1:${#value}-2}"
    fi

    esc_key=$(json_escape "$key")
    esc_val=$(json_escape "$value")

    if [[ $first -eq 0 ]]; then
      printf ','
    fi
    first=0

    printf '"%s":"%s"' "$esc_key" "$esc_val"
  done < "$file"

  printf '}'
}

send_health_report() {
  local overall_status="$1"
  local env_json

  env_json=$(build_env_json "$ENV_FILE")

  # Full payload
  local payload
  payload=$(printf '{"status":"%s","ports":["%s"],"env":%s}' \
    "$overall_status" \
    "${PORTS[*]}" \
    "$env_json")

  echo "Sending health report to ${HEALTH_REPORT_URL}..."
  curl -sS -X POST \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d "$payload" \
    "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
      echo "WARNING: Failed to send health report to monitoring endpoint." >&2

    if ! check_port "$HOST" "$port"; then

    echo "All services are healthy."
  else
    echo "One or more services are DOWN."
  fi

  exit "$overall_status"
